messages:
Maya (sales): Rui — quick kickoff: AltMethods wants a preprod POC to replace CompetitorQ. Endpoints: /complete and /annotate. Main asks: response shape parity, stable spans, and identical throttling signals. Can we scope blockers?
Rui - AltMethods: Must-haves: 1) 'confidence' float on annotate; 2) HTML entities preserved; 3) 429 vs 503 behavior identical; 4) preserve a request_id header so their observability tooling keeps continuity.
Ethan (solutions): We can stand up a tiny compat proxy that maps their SDK to Redwood. Plan: header mapping, response shim to map choices->outputs, include both byte_offset and utf16_char offsets for spans, and expose X-Redwood-Compat: CompetitorQ.
Talia (security): Security checklist: no PII retained in logs, BYOK support for any persisted artifacts, architecture diagram for KMS envelope flow, and list of log fields.
Hiro (legal): Procurement needs SOC2 Type II + DPA. Also clarify subprocessors and where EU PII is processed.
Rui - AltMethods: EU residency required for some of their customers. Also they rely on stable span IDs across retries.
Ethan (solutions): For stable span IDs we'll return deterministic ids: sha256(request_id||span_text||start_char). We'll document the algorithm and provide a test harness. For tokenizer deltas we'll include orig_token_index when available.
Maya (sales): Billing question from their finance: they bill per-request; we charge per-token. For POC can we offer a capped credit and an approximate conversion model?
Ethan (solutions): Yes — POC cap OK. We'll provide a conversion spreadsheet estimating tokens per request based on their sample payloads.
Talia (security): On BYOK: need key rotation policy and proof that request_id is never logged to public dashboards. Provide sec_arch.md in the repo.
Ethan (solutions): Will add sec_arch.md, COMPAT_README, and an error_map.md that lists 429/503 semantics and mapped headers. Also adding a small curl example for QA.
Rui - AltMethods: QA will run nightly diffs against CompetitorQ and expect top-5 parity. Can harness emit compact JSON diffs?
Ethan (solutions): Yes, diff script will output a compact summary and full artifacts on mismatch. We'll also expose an endpoint /compat-metrics for nightly reports.
deploy-bot: staging deploy started for branch `altmethods-compat` build 2026.08.11-09; smoke tests queued.
Hiro (legal): I'll send the DPA draft to procurement and include a provisional subprocessor list.
Talia (security): One more: ensure temporary cache TTL <= 1h and that cache entries don't include full prompt text.
Ethan (solutions): Agreed. Cache only stores hashes + metadata (ttl 30m). No full payloads.
Maya (sales): Action items: 1) Ethan add COMPAT_README, sec_arch.md, error_map.md; 2) Talia to provide audit fields list; 3) Hiro send DPA; 4) Maya to share POC cap by EOD.
Rui - AltMethods: All good. We'll schedule a POC sync early next week. Thanks team.
